behavior: summarize(records, width_ms) equals window_stats(dedupe_latest(records), width_ms). The migrated target must call the migrated dedupe_latest and window_stats, not a re-derived copy of either, so that an accepted P1 or P2 ruling reaches P3 automatically. The frozen Python API and error behaviour are preserved exactly. Ordering: Inherits dedupe-semantics then bucket-semantics. Equal-sequence ties therefore change the summarized values with input order.

outputs.rows: list[tuple[str, int, int, int, int, int]] identical to window_stats over the deduplicated batch
